_comment: Public-source demo theses so anyone can try audit.py without a paid subscription. Two are deliberately broken - see the 'planted_flaw' field. Install them with: python consolidate.py --profile demo --source demo/theses.demo.json

theses.claim: BWXT Commercial Operations revenue grows at least 45% for FY2026, in line with raised guidance.
theses.mechanism: Commercial nuclear demand across reactor designs plus recent acquisitions. Q2 2026 commercial revenue grew 72% including 33% organic.
kill_criteria: FY2026 Commercial Operations revenue growth comes in below 45%.
theses.notes: Should pass. Names a reported figure, at the right level, with a date.

theses.claim: US Navy submarine procurement stays at two Virginia-class plus one Columbia-class per year through FY2028.
theses.mechanism: Steady submarine rates keep BWXT's naval reactor lines continuously utilised.
kill_criteria: Any Navy 30-year shipbuilding plan or enacted appropriation through FY2028 reduces either rate.
theses.source_document: US Navy 30-year shipbuilding plan; enacted defense appropriations
theses.notes: Should pass. The publisher is a government agency rather than the company - observability does not require the company to be the source.

theses.claim: Sterling's electrical business will improve its margins over the next 18 months.
theses.mechanism: Management is targeting a 3-5 point improvement in electrical margins through better project selection and training.
kill_criteria: Management reports that technician training programmes are behind schedule.
theses.notes: PLANTED FLAW: no company reports training programme status on a schedule. It would surface only if management chose to mention it - and if the news were bad, they would not. Silence and absence become indistinguishable.

theses.claim: Sterling's shift away from low-margin highway work will push Transportation Solutions margins higher.
theses.mechanism: Walking away from low-bid projects frees equipment and crews for higher-margin work.
kill_criteria: Consolidated operating margin comes in below the prior year's level in the next two quarterly reports.
theses.notes: PLANTED FLAW: the claim is about one segment, the criterion measures the whole company. Transportation margins could rise exactly as predicted while a weak housing segment drags the consolidated figure down - killing a thesis that was right.
